title: Senior HPC Cloud Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our HPC Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads. You will be the primary architecture reviewer and performance champion for new data center clusters being built across multiple sites globally.

**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own the build-out and day-to-day operation of NVIDIA's VLSI high-performance compute environments in the public cloud, and the repeatable patterns that let us stand up the next environment faster than the last.
* Bring up and operate large compute clusters on Google Cloud end to end - instance provisioning, machine images, OS pipelines, networking, identity and quota management.
* Build the automation that makes cluster bring-up reproducible: infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, image build pipelines, and host lifecycle automation including hostname and identity preservation across maintenance events.
* Extend the same patterns to new on-premises data centers so cloud and on-prem run on one toolchain rather than two, and work with networking and storage teams on cross-site connectivity, latency budgets, and what is cross-mounted versus kept site-local.
* This is a hands-on technical role. You will debug at depth when clusters misbehave - image and boot issues, mount failures, scheduler-host interactions, capacity and quota problems - and partner with the scheduling and operations engineers so what you build is operable by the whole team, not only by you.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in infrastructure engineering, with substantial time running production compute at scale.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with a major public cloud, Google Cloud preferred - compute, networking, IAM, storage, quotas, and the operational realities of running thousands of instances rather than tens.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code and configuration management skills (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent), plus experience with machine image build and OS lifecycle pipelines for large fleets.
* Solid Linux systems administration and troubleshooting: filesystems, NFS mounts and latency, networking, boot and image pipelines.
* Working understanding of data center and network fundamentals for compute-intensive workloads - topology, bandwidth and latency characterisation, and the practical limits of cross-site operation - along with familiarity with batch schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent) and how compute nodes join, leave and are managed within them.
* Strong Python automation, experience bringing a new environment, cluster or data center online end to end, and the ability to work effectively across time zones. Semiconductor/EDA exposure is a plus, not a requirement.

Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.

* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Configuration Specialist
description:
**Purpose (of the role):**


The Configuration Specialist operates within a structured, scalable delivery model focused on executing well\-defined configuration activities through a centralised intake process (e.g. ServiceNow). Work items are assigned with detailed requirements, contextual information, and predefined standards via structured request forms, enabling consistent, high\-quality delivery at scale.


This role is responsible for accurately executing repeatable, process\-driven tasks using established methodologies, documentation, and configuration standards. The Specialist applies attention to detail and discipline to ensure outputs are reliable, traceable, and aligned with global best practices.


Operating as part of a global delivery capability, the role emphasises efficiency, consistency, and continuous improvement. There is no direct client engagement; instead, the focus is on dependable execution, effective use of tooling (including AI\-assisted capabilities), and contribution to reusable knowledge assets such as the Services Catalogue.

**Clinisys' AI Philosophy**


Building an **AI‑first organisation** is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. We **must drive an AI\-first sense of purpose and urgency.**

**Job Summary:**


1\. **Essential Functions / Job Responsibilities**

* Execute configuration tasks assigned through structured intake systems (e.g. ServiceNow), ensuring full adherence to the instructions, context, and acceptance criteria provided within each request.
* Interpret and apply detailed work instructions, templates, and supporting documentation to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes across repeatable configuration activities.
* Operate within a process\-driven delivery framework, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with defined service levels and quality benchmarks.
* Follow established escalation pathways when task inputs, requirements, or instructions are unclear or incomplete, ensuring risks to quality or timelines are proactively managed.
* Maintain a strong focus on consistency and standardisation by adhering strictly to configuration standards, governance frameworks, and catalogue\-defined approaches.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of intake quality by identifying gaps, ambiguities, or inefficiencies in task instructions and providing structured feedback to upstream roles (e.g. Configuration Architects, intake reviewers).
* Develop and maintain configuration artefacts within the Services Catalogue, ensuring outputs are reusable, well\-documented, and aligned to standard patterns.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools and automation capabilities, where approved, to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve accuracy across repetitive tasks.
* Ensure all configuration activities are fully documented, version\-controlled, and traceable in line with governance and audit requirements.
* Collaborate with global teams in a structured manner to support throughput and workload balancing, without direct client interaction.


2\. **Skills needed to be successful**

* Knowledge of configuration management principles, tools, and implementation practices within enterprise software environments.
* Understanding of AI\-assisted tools for configuration, documentation, and automation, with awareness of secure and compliant usage.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with the ability to interpret requirements and translate them into effective configurations.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in configuration tools and familiarity with scripting or automation platforms.
* Ability to leverage AI tools to support documentation, configuration standardisation, and knowledge management.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross\-functional and global teams.
* High attention to detail with strong documentation and quality assurance capabilities.


3\. **Required Experience \& Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in configuration management, software implementation, or related technical roles.
* Familiarity with enterprise software solutions and configuration\-driven implementations.
* Exposure to automation tools, scripting, or AI\-assisted development environments is desirable.
* Ability to work in a structured, process\-driven environment with strong adherence to standards and governance.


4\. **Preferred Experience \& Education**

* Experience with Clinisys solutions or similar healthcare/LIMS platforms.
* Exposure to AI tools (e.g., Copilot or similar) for documentation, configuration, or automation tasks.
* Experience in building or maintaining reusable catalogues, templates, or configuration repositories.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and global delivery models.
* Strong focus on continuous improvement, standardization, and operational efficiency.


5\. **Supervisory Responsibilities**


None

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain
description:
### **Role Overview**



As an L6 Software Development Manager in AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain, you will define the strategic vision for your team, establish a roadmap, and successfully deliver software that powers one of the world's largest and most complex physical infrastructure supply chains. You will independently manage a team of SDEs building large\-scale distributed systems that enable AWS to procure, manufacture, ship, and deploy hundreds of thousands of server and network racks into data centers globally across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions.



Strategic Ownership


* Define the strategic vision for your team, partnering effectively with customers and stakeholders across the supply chain lifecycle — from demand planning and material supportability to manufacturing, logistics, and DC deployment.
* Establish a roadmap and successfully deliver software that executes that vision, aligned with the end\-to\-end supply chain needs spanning systems like S\&OP POR, RP3, Build Planner, Fulfillment Planner, and the Infrastructure Control Tower.
* Make crisp, independent decisions about what projects move forward and in what priority order, balancing competing priorities across demand forecasting, capacity planning, fulfillment optimization, and observability.
* Write narratives, PR/FAQs, and other strategic documentation to drive alignment and decision\-making.


Technical Domain Your team will work on one or more of the following areas:


* Real\-time observability platforms — powering the Infrastructure Control Tower that tracks 100K\+ active demands through stage progression, dwell times, blocker reason codes, and checkpoint milestones.
* AI/ML\-driven forecasting — demand planning, ETA prediction, and supply\-demand matching across 130\+ component categories and 1,400\+ Superset Fungibility Groups (SFGs).
* Optimization engines — capacity planning systems that match server/network demand (converted to kW) against DC power supply at lineup, breaker, site, and meter\-site levels.

Multi\-agent orchestration systems — coordinating fulfillment across vendors, manufacturing sites, and DC positions in priority order (ML Network* Non\-ML).
* Data pipelines — processing millions of events daily across the fulfillment pipeline from Purchase Request through to Handoff.


People Leadership


* Independently manage a team of SDEs; hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals.
* Assess SDE performance effectively; manage both high and low performers and take effective action addressing employee concerns.
* Hire, develop, and promote SDEs, delegating appropriately based on the strength and development objectives of individuals on your team.
* Build an effective development process that consistently delivers software with minimal defects and system disruption.


Customer \& Operational Excellence


* Define metrics to measure customer experience, team development progress, and operational excellence across the supply chain systems your team owns.
* Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to the needs of internal customers — service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, manufacturing partners, and logistics operators.
* Ensure your team adheres to SLAs and effectively manages software operations.
* Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks. Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders.


Deliver Results


* Consistently deliver software with minimal defects and system disruption.
* Improve the quality of software owned by your team and operational performance metrics under your leadership.
* Communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences — from engineering peers to senior leadership.
